user.title: Sub-Zero Group Login
user.description:
Sign in with the email and password of your Sub-Zero Owner's App account. The password is used once to sign in and is never stored.

If your account uses multi-factor authentication, tick **Log in with browser instead**.

manual.title: Sub-Zero Group Browser Login
manual.description:
Sub-Zero's login flow redirects to a URL that browsers cannot open, so you'll need to grab it from your browser's developer console.

1. **Before** clicking the login link below, open developer tools (F12 or Cmd+Option+I) and switch to the **Console** tab.
2. Open this link to log in: [Sub-Zero Login]({auth_url})
3. Log in with your Sub-Zero account. The redirect page will fail to load — that's expected.
4. In the Console, find the navigation error containing a URL starting with `msauth.com.subzero.group.owners.app://auth?code=...`.
5. Copy that full URL and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Sub-Zero Group
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Sub-Zero session has expired. Sign in again to keep the integration running. Make sure you use the same account this integration was originally set up with. The password is used once to sign in and is never stored.

If your account uses multi-factor authentication, tick **Log in with browser instead**.

abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The account you logged in with is different from the one this integration was set up with. Log in with the original account, or remove this integration and add the new one.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Please restart Home Assistant and try again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Sub-Zero service. Please try again in a moment.

error.mfa_or_interactive_required: Sub-Zero requires an extra sign-in step (for example MFA). Use the browser method below.

init.title: Enable Local Control
init.description: Select an appliance to enable local control. Make sure a door on the appliance is open, then click Submit. The PIN will be displayed on the appliance.

enter_pin.title: Enter PIN
enter_pin.description: A 6-digit PIN should now be showing on the appliance display. Enter it below.

abort.not_loaded: Integration is not loaded. Please restart Home Assistant.
abort.no_local_devices: No appliances support local control. Local control is only available for older CAT-module appliances.

error.invalid_pin: PIN must be exactly 6 digits (numbers only).
error.wrong_pin: PIN rejected by the appliance. Make sure you entered the correct 6-digit code from the display.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the appliance. Make sure it is online and reachable on the network.
